transcript:

Speaker B: Okay sir, na check pannitu confirm panren. [Okay sir, let me check and confirm.]
Speaker A: Sure. Oru nimisham, pesitu vandhuren. [Sure. One minute, I will take this call and come back.]
Speaker B: Ma'am, sorry for the inconvenience. River view rooms ipo maintenance-la iruku. Instead premium suite offer pannalama? [Ma'am, sorry for the inconvenience. River view rooms are under maintenance. Can I offer a premium suite instead?]
Speaker C: No, it's okay, not a problem. You can show me any other room, if it is okay means, we will go for that.
Speaker B: Yeah sure, ma'am. Yeah, then I'll look for other suggestions.
Speaker A: Hada! Nee ivlo nalla English pesuvanu na nenaikavey illa. Ivlo naala yen sollavey illa? [Wow! I never thought you could speak English so well. Why didn't you tell me all this while?]
Speaker C: Naanum English-la weak-ah dhan irundhen. Apram SpeakX use panna aarambichen. Adhuku apram enoda English improve aydichi. [I was also weak in English. Then I started using SpeakX. After that, my English improved.]
Speaker A: SpeakX-ah? [SpeakX?]
Speaker C: Aama. SpeakX oru AI-powered English learning app. Idhula iruka AI English teacher kooda daily pesi practice pannaley podhum. Nammaloda communication skill nallavey improve aagum. Daily 10 to 15 minutes spend pannaley podhum. Just two weeks-la nammalala English nalla pesa mudiyum. [Yes. SpeakX is an AI-powered English learning app. Just practicing daily with the AI English teacher is enough to improve communication skills. Spending 10-15 minutes daily can make you fluent in just two weeks.]
Speaker A: Adhu sari. Appo namma savings-la idhula dhan pogudha? [I see. So are our savings going into this?]
Speaker C: Adhala illa. Just 2 rupees-ley trial pack avail pannika mudiyum. And romba affordable-um kooda. [Not at all. You can get a trial pack for just 2 rupees. It is very affordable.]
Speaker A: Appo sari. Na inikey SpeakX download panni en communication-ah improve panren. [Alright then. I will download SpeakX today and improve my communication.]
Speaker C: Neengalum English fluent-ah kathukanumna, udaney SpeakX app-ah download pannunga. [If you also want to learn fluent English, download the SpeakX app immediately.]
